import json,sys,subprocess,hashlib,random,os
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor as T
D=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))+'/'
SP=open(D+'prompt.txt').read(); ph=hashlib.sha1(SP.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
cf=D+'cache_%s.json'%ph; C=json.load(open(cf)) if os.path.exists(cf) else {}
def ask(t):
    if t in C: return t,C[t]
    r=subprocess.run(['claude','-p','--model','sonnet','--bare','--tools','','--no-session-persistence','--system-prompt',SP,'CARD QUESTION:\n'+t],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,cwd='/tmp',stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    return t,r.stdout.strip().lower() or 'ERR:'+r.stderr[:80]
def run(rows):
    with T(8) as ex:
        for t,v in ex.map(ask,rows): C[t]=v
    json.dump(C,open(cf,'w'),ensure_ascii=False)
    return [C[t] for t in rows]
if __name__=='__main__':
    c=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); 
    ins=c[sys.argv[2]]; outs=c[sys.argv[3]]; n=int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv)>4 else 10**6
    r=random.Random(7); 
    if n<len(outs): outs=r.sample(outs,n)
    ii=run(ins); oo=run(outs)
    import collections
    print(ph,'in',collections.Counter(ii).most_common(5)); print('out',collections.Counter(oo).most_common(5))
    fn=[t for t,v in zip(ins,ii) if v=='none']; fp=[(v,t) for t,v in zip(outs,oo) if v!='none']
    print('recall %.3f fp %d/%d'%(1-len(fn)/len(ins),len(fp),len(outs)))
    if '-v' in sys.argv:
        for t in fn: print('FN',t[-200:].replace('\n',' '))
        for v,t in fp: print('FP',v,t[-200:].replace('\n',' '))
E

head='''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PreToolUse/AskUserQuestion hook - refuse a card whose ONLY questions are in a class the owner delegated.

Item CARDS_ENFORCE_DELEGATED_CLASSES_STOP. design/RimMandrake/delegation_policy.md:
  s1 \`scope\`   - work order, which item next, helper count, whether to continue / start now or later
  s2.4 \`twin\`  - applying an existing ruling to a case it does not name (campaign copy, sister biome, sibling def)
Measured: 29 ordering cards (81% agreement), ~235 typed go-aheads, 9 twin cards (8 yes) in 3 weeks.

A model reads each question, because regexes never generalised: five sealed reads of tuned patterns gave recall
0.19, 0.62, 0.90, 0.50, 0.58 (DELEGATED_CARDS_FIX_HELD_OUT_RECALL). JUDGE names the class, VETO re-reads a positive.
False positives are the only way this hook does harm, so it refuses only when
  * EVERY question in the call is judged delegated and survives the veto, AND
